name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Coloring Card Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality natural plywood with a smooth surface and a thickness of approximately 3mm. 
    - The wood is lightweight, durable, eco-friendly, and safe for children, making it ideal for coloring and creative activities.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 5 x 5 inches ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
    - Designed as a single-layer wooden card with built-in slots to securely hold crayons, colored pencils, or markers.
    - Compact and easy to hold, perfect for small hands.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Laser-cut Technology:
    Crafted using precision laser-cut technology, ensuring clean edges, smooth contours, and highly detailed designs.
    The engraved outlines are clear and well-defined, helping guide children and beginners to color neatly within the lines, making the coloring experience fun, relaxing, and easy.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Serves as a coloring card and crayon holder in one product. The specially designed curved laser-cut slots and circular holes are engineered to securely hold crayons in place, preventing them from slipping out while still allowing easy insertion and removal.
    - Encourages creativity, imagination, and fine motor skill development.
    - Ideal for kids’ activities, classrooms, art corners, travel entertainment, or family bonding time.
    - Can also be displayed as a decorative keepsake after coloring.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and creative gift suitable for kids and adults alike, perfect for birthdays, Valentine’s Day, Christmas, Easter, back-to-school gifts, classroom rewards, or any special occasion.
    - An excellent choice for parents, teachers, and anyone looking for a fun, educational, and meaningful wooden gift.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Wooden Coloring Card Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
